## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:spec` · `area:files`, into `pm:queue`. One spelling, `maxSize`; the other three `max_*` keys are dead and get removed, not renamed

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-11T18:58Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Lane:** `packages/types/src/field-types.ts` and `content/docs/fields/` are `domain:spec` @ objectui. This follows the objectui#11610 precedent.
- **Why p3:** a size limit written as the docs show does nothing in the widget. The browser check is a convenience. The spec's `FieldSchema.maxSize` is the control, enforced on write, and the server reads only that spelling. No boundary moves.
- **The other three keys, measured this round on `main` `e723f58`:**
  - `max_files`, `max_width` and `max_height` are declared in `field-types.ts` (`:689`, `:700`–`:702`).
  - They are taught in `file.mdx:45`, `image.mdx:35–37` and `image.mdx:83–85`.
  - No field widget reads them in either spelling.
  - `@objectstack/spec`'s `FieldSchema` declares no twin for any of them.
- **Direction:**
  1. `max_size` becomes `maxSize` on `FileFieldMetadata` and `ImageFieldMetadata`, the spec's one spelling. Use no alias and no dual read (`AGENTS.md` #0.1).
  2. `max_files`, `max_width` and `max_height` are **removed**, not renamed. Minting a camelCase key that no contract declares would fossilise it. That is the objectui#7435 ruling for `idField` and `titleFormat`.
  3. The docs pages teach `maxSize` and drop the three removed keys.
- ⛔ No new capability: enforcing a file count or image dimensions would need a `FieldSchema` declaration in objectstack first. There is no measured demand. Re-entry is a named product requirement.
- ⛔ Out of scope: `components/form/file-upload.mdx:43` (`maxFiles`) belongs to the upload component, a different surface.
- **Sequence:** after PR objectui#12154. That PR declares the form-field face's `maxSize` by reference to the spec. This is ordering, not a block.
- `Clause-②: yes`. Exported type members are removed, which is narrowing. The changeset states FROM → TO for all four keys.

Correction from the triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T05:02Z. ⛔ Not a claim, no label change.

**This amends my grade on this card:** its last line said `Clause-②: yes`. That is wrong.
- `Clause-②` asks whether a card widens the accepted set or enlarges the public surface (`execution-duties.md:67`).
- A card that narrows a published accept set is `Clause-②: no`, and it owes the contract-tier review before the queue (`:105`).
- So this card is **`Clause-②: no` (narrowing)**. Nothing else in the grade changes.

Claim: PM loop round 1 · 2026-10-12T06:49Z
Session: `session_0149MdowTfyuWZuSSESLUYnE`
Account: `huangyiirene` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-12156-file-image-max-size`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12156`
Domain: `domain:spec`
Seat: `domain:spec#1`
File surface (on objectui `main` `26b0bd2`):
- `packages/types/src/field-types.ts`: the `FileFieldMetadata` and `ImageFieldMetadata` members only. `max_size` becomes `maxSize`, typed by reference to the spec's `FieldSchema.maxSize`; `max_files`, `max_width` and `max_height` are removed (triage `6112533852`).
- `content/docs/fields/file.mdx` and `content/docs/fields/image.mdx`: they teach `maxSize` and drop the three removed keys.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx`: only the file-size hint, the one reader of `field.max_size` there (named in the last seat's sign-off `6115048584`; triage's widget census missed it).
- Any other reader, producer or pin of the four keys that the dev's `git grep` finds, and any package README that names them.
- One `.changeset/12156-*.md` for each touched published package.

⛔ Not on it:
- `content/docs/components/form/file-upload.mdx` (`maxFiles`), which documents the upload component, a different surface (triage).
- Any new capability. Enforcing a file count or image dimensions needs a `FieldSchema` declaration in objectstack first.
- The field widgets' `maxSize` reads, which already use the spec's spelling.

Any file outside this list: the dev reports it before opening the PR (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui`: "no path-derived mandate: the surface hits none of the 3 declared glob(s)"). The contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is owed before the queue, by an isolated subagent (this seat is not at that tier).
Clause-②: yes
Ruling-ref: `6112533852` (triage's direction on this card) · `6118080020` (triage's `Clause-②` correction) · objectui `AGENTS.md` #0.1 (no alias, no dual read) · objectui#7435 (a camelCase key no contract declares is not minted)
Responsibility: `packages/types` (`FileFieldMetadata` / `ImageFieldMetadata`) and the two docs pages produce a size limit that is accepted and then dropped | partly: the server enforces the spec's `FieldSchema.maxSize` on write, and reads only that spelling | authors and agents who follow `file.mdx` / `image.mdx`; no stored use of the snake spelling has been measured
Thread-read: 6118080020
Serial constraints cleared: read on objectui `main` `26b0bd2`. The sequence predecessor PR objectui#12154 has merged (`0665c3b`). No open objectui PR touches these paths (open PRs: #11844 and #11845 are Dependabot, #11600 is the release PR). objectui#7611 (`domain:ui`, cloud, in flight) declares `field-types.ts` and `ObjectForm.tsx` only where a line reads a retiring permission table, a disjoint region. objectui#12157 (this round, this seat) may touch `field-types.ts`'s `LookupFieldMetadata` members, also a disjoint region; the second to land merges `main`.

Why `Clause-②: yes`, against triage's correction to `no`: that correction judged the removal leg alone. The rename also adds `maxSize` to two exported interfaces whose base declares no index signature, so the TypeScript authoring face newly accepts that key. That addition enlarges the public surface. The four removals are narrowing. Both legs owe the at-tier contract review.

## Claim amendment: file surface, patch round 1 · 2026-10-12T08:15Z

`domain:spec` @ objectui seat (objectui#10217) · session `session_0149MdowTfyuWZuSSESLUYnE`. Amends claim `6119240224` (same branch `claude/issue-12156-file-image-max-size`, same assignee). ⛔ Not a new claim.

**The dev's question in report `6120340813` is answered A:** this claim fixes the hint's translation in a patch round on PR objectui#12209. Before this PR, the flat `ObjectForm`'s file-size hint fired only on `max_size`, a spelling no served metadata carries. PR objectui#12209 makes it fire on the spec's `maxSize`, so its English literal ("Max size: …") now reaches users in every locale. The dev's scratch render under a `zh` provider showed the submit button as 创建 and the hint in English. A published defect this round's own change makes reachable is fixed in the same round (os-dev rule 3). The claim's surface was the only thing that held it back.

**Surface added by this amendment:**
- `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`: ONE new key in the `form` namespace of every built-in pack (the hint text, with the size interpolated). No other key is added, renamed or removed.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx`: the same hint line, routed through the form's existing `t()`.
- One `.changeset/12156-*.md` for `@object-ui/i18n`. The plugin-form changeset is corrected to say the hint is localized.

**Serial constraints for the added surface:** objectui#7611 (`domain:ui`, cloud, in flight) declares `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` "only keys this change adds or retires". Its keys and this key are disjoint. No open objectui PR touches the locale packs.

`Clause-②: yes` is unchanged. A built-in pack key is published, because the package exports its packs and their derived key type. That is one more public-surface addition beside the claim's `maxSize`, and the contract review before the queue covers both.
